description.value: Nicholas Sonntag TidePools Aquarium is a collect-and-release marine aquarium operated by BlueAct Marine Society inside the Gibsons Public Market on the Sunshine Coast. It showcases over 70 local species across interactive touch tanks and exhibits representing Rocky Intertidal, Eelgrass, Kelp Forest, Deep Sea, and other habitats. The non-profit facility pairs open exhibits with educational camps, conservation programs, and community events focused on coastal ecology.

address.value: 473 Gower Point Road, Gibsons, BC V0N 1V4

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides address, phone, and operational details. None of the cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned on the website or in OSM tags, so all remain null. A notable discrepancy exists between OSM opening_hours (Sa-Su only) and the website (Tuesday-Sunday), which is flagged in concerns.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag (Sa-Su 10:00-17:00; Mo-Fr off) conflicts with website, which states Tuesday-Sunday open, closed Monday. OSM tag is likely outdated.
OSM record has no address or phone; both sourced from website only.
OSM name 'TidePools Aquarium' differs slightly from the full official name used on the website ('Nicholas Sonntag TidePools Aquarium'), though this appears intentional branding.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, actively operating marine aquarium and community hub in Gibsons — a notable destination stop for touring cyclists exploring the Sunshine Coast.

wow_evidence: Collect-and-release marine aquarium with touch tanks inside Gibsons Public Market — real small aquarium (a tier below Ucluelet's 3/3).
blurb: Touch-tank marine aquarium inside the Gibsons Public Market.
